We need to determine appropriate charge(s) from the lexicon based on facts.

Facts: Person pretended to be looking for a spouse, used online dating, arranged a fake mother, got trust, then transferred 71,000 yuan from victim's bank card to his own, spent it, also got a gold ring purchased by victim for 2541.94 yuan. Total fraud 73541.94 yuan. No marriage formalities. He disappeared.

Thus this is fraud (诈骗). Possibly also "合同诈骗"? No contract? He pretended to marry, but no contract. The lexicon includes "诈骗" generic. Also maybe "骗取财物" is just fraud. So charge: 诈骗.

 "final_answer": "[罪名]诈骗<eoa>"
}
